# npnormalize

npnormalize turns nonprofit names and addresses into keys that can be
matched. It is the normalizer shared by three packages:

- **npmatch** normalizes each record it matches;
- **matchdb** stores the same keys for every organization it holds;
- **pfmatch** normalizes grant recipients before matching them.

A record and the reference it is matched against must be normalized by
the same code. Otherwise matches quietly stop being found, with no
error. This package holds that code in one place, and fingerprints it.

## Install

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("Nonprofit-Open-Data-Collective/npnormalize")
```

## Use

``` r

library(npnormalize)

d <- data.frame(name   = c("The Children's Museum of NH", "St. Luke's Hospital Fdn, Inc."),
                dba    = "",
                street = c("6 Washington Pl Ste 300", "PO Box 1558"),
                unit   = NA,
                zip5   = c("03820", "75201-1234"),
                zip_plus4 = NA,
                state  = c("NH", "Texas"))
np_normalize(d)[, c("name_key", "name_core", "street_key", "street_unit_id", "zip5", "state_abb")]
#>                 name_key                       name_core      street_key street_unit_id  zip5 state_abb
#> 1 CHILDRENS MUSEUM OF NH             CHILDRENS MUSEUM NH 6 WASHINGTON PL            300 03820        NH
#> 2   SAINT LUKES HOSPITAL SAINT LUKES HOSPITAL FOUNDATION     PO BOX 1558           <NA> 75201        TX
```

**Input columns.** The frame needs the columns `name`, `dba`, `street`,
`unit`, `zip5`, `zip_plus4` and `state`, with `NA` or `""` where a value
is unknown. These are npmatch’s canonical fields, which
[`npmatch::np_query()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/npmatch/reference/np_query.html)
and
[`npmatch::np_reference()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/npmatch/reference/np_reference.html)
produce from any dataset. `division` is used when present.

**Columns added:** \* name keys: `name_key`, `name_full`, `name_core`,
`dba_key`; \* name features: `name_form`, `name_nums`, `name_ord`,
`name_placeholder`; \* street parts: `street_key`, `street_num`,
`street_name`, `street_type`, `street_unit`, `street_unit_id`,
`is_po_box`; \* ZIP parts: `zip5`, `zip3`, `zip9`; \* `state_abb`.

[`np_name_core()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/npnormalize/reference/np_name_core.md)
and
[`np_name_placeholder()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/npnormalize/reference/np_name_core.md)
work on bare name strings.

**Statistics over the keys:** \*
[`np_name_freq()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/npnormalize/reference/np_name_freq.md)
counts how many records share each name key. \*
[`np_token_idf()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/npnormalize/reference/np_token_idf.md)
weights each name token by how rare it is. \*
[`np_addr_freq()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/npnormalize/reference/np_addr_freq.md)
counts the records at each address and suite, and classifies the address
as federated, shared, building or cluster.

## The signature

``` r

np_normalize_signature()
#> [1] "v1-3e7b9f9d59bbb19e"
```

The signature is a hash of the rule tables and functions behind the keys
and statistics, so it changes when their behaviour changes. \* **What it
ignores:** comments and formatting. \* **What it leaves out:** the
matching code in npmatch (comparison, scoring, vetoes), because nothing
it computes is stored.

Anything that stores keys should stamp the signature when it is built,
and refuse to load under a different one. matchdb does this for its
database, bundles and tranches. `np_normalize_signature(detail = TRUE)`
shows which rule table or function moved.

The code was moved here from npmatch unchanged, so the signature is the
one npmatch reported (`dev/EXTRACTION.md`). A test pins the value.
Changing the normalizer is allowed, but it is a deliberate release:
update the pin and rebuild what depends on it.

# Package index

## Normalize records

Turn names and addresses into keys that can be matched.

- [`np_normalize()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/npnormalize/reference/np_normalize.md)
  : Normalize a query or reference frame
- [`np_name_core()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/npnormalize/reference/np_name_core.md)
  [`np_name_placeholder()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/npnormalize/reference/np_name_core.md)
  : Exact-lookup name key and placeholder check for raw name strings

## Statistics over the keys

Count how common names, tokens and addresses are, for weighting and
blocking.

- [`np_name_freq()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/npnormalize/reference/np_name_freq.md)
  : Name-key frequency table for a reference corpus
- [`np_token_idf()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/npnormalize/reference/np_token_idf.md)
  : Per-token inverse document frequency for a reference corpus
- [`np_addr_freq()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/npnormalize/reference/np_addr_freq.md)
  : Address-sharing statistics for a reference corpus

## The signature

Fingerprint the normalizer so stored keys can refuse to load under a
different one.

- [`np_normalize_signature()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/npnormalize/reference/np_normalize_signature.md)
  : Fingerprint the normalizer

## Building blocks

Tokenizers, stopwords and the rule tables the keys are built from.

- [`np_tokenize()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/npnormalize/reference/np_tokenize.md)
  [`np_doc_freq()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/npnormalize/reference/np_tokenize.md)
  [`np_addr_key()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/npnormalize/reference/np_tokenize.md)
  [`np_unit_id()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/npnormalize/reference/np_tokenize.md)
  [`np_state_abb()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/npnormalize/reference/np_tokenize.md)
  : Internals npmatch and matchdb call
- [`np_stopwords()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/npnormalize/reference/np_stopwords.md)
  : Blocking stopwords
- [`np_name_rules()`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/npnormalize/reference/np_name_rules.md)
  : Name-normalization rule tables

## Package

- [`npnormalize`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/npnormalize/reference/npnormalize-package.md)
  [`npnormalize-package`](https://nonprofit-open-data-collective.github.io/npnormalize/reference/npnormalize-package.md)
  : npnormalize: nonprofit names and addresses as matchable keys
